scope: Named families in audited canonical frontier, route contract, Main XXIV/XXV handoffs, Main XXI-XXIV archived frontiers, gearbox/tool atlases and directly referenced dossiers. Not all possible experiments or all unknown repository documents.
relation_convention: Unless an explanation names a weaker target, relations concern full base-16 normality. NECESSARY rows include strict weaker rungs. Conditional implications retain every qualifier. OBSERVER_ONLY does not assert a new arithmetic bound.
implementation_convention: These labels classify mathematical representation requirements, not a claim that every row has been implemented in the current production compiler. Direct finite response assumes its authenticated source-labelled inputs.
